text:
alex: Heads-up — noticed a reproducible spike in client CPU + long task stacks when switching dashboard tabs (charts render).
tanya: repro steps? on canary or prod?
alex: canary. steps: open org dashboard, switch from Overview -> Usage -> Heatmap quickly (~within 1s). flame shows big GC + telemetry serialization.
ravi: could be kvcache eviction thrashing or a large bundle eval on tab switch. any network waterfall?
alex: network ok, bundle already cached. suspect we instantiate lots of chart workers and each asks for full timeseries payload.
kevin: two possible regressions: 1) recent prefetch change that warms chart stores on hover (might overfetch), 2) LRU change in kvcache that flushes prefixes on route change.
tanya: noted the prefetch PR — @kevin did that change also bump cross-tab sharedlib?
kevin: yes I landed a small optimization: prefetch now requests route-level keys during HOVER to reduce cold-starts. didn't expect multiple tab switches in <1s.
kevin: sample of the prefetch query: `GET /api/v1/charts/prefetch?keys=route:org:overview:timeseries&range=7d`
ravi: if those prefetches run concurrently we may create N inflight identical requests and then each resolves parsing huge payload into VDOM -> CPU spike. should dedupe.
alex: telemetry shows 8 inflight prefetches for some users. we also stamp telemetry for each. that explains GC + serialization backlog.
tanya: also saw kvcache eviction logs at the same time: `kvcache: prefix flush org:1234:charts` triggered by LRU 0.97 threshold. means we don't benefit from warmed entries.
kevin: that eviction could be because prefetches are creating transient keys that push hot keys out. bad interaction.
ravi: short proposal: 1) add dedupe at prefetch layer (coalesce identical inflight), 2) switch prefetch from full payload -> lightweight index, 3) change kvcache policy to pin route-level prefixes for 30s during navigation.
tanya: agree. also need to mute telemetry events for prefetch to avoid noise and cost. keep a sampling flag like `prefetch.telemetry_sample=0.01` for now.
kevin: I'll revert telemetry increase and add dedupe (should be quick). can we ship pinning as a config toggle to private deployments first?
alex: yes toggle is fine. main thing is mitigate user-facing jank. can we feature flag dedupe behind canary?
kevin: will do canary -> 25% -> 100. will annotate changelog.
ravi: I'll prepare a lightweight endpoint that returns only index/meta for charts: `GET /api/v1/charts/index?range=7d` so UI can fetch detail lazily.
tanya: also add a short-term client-side guard: avoid triggering prefetch on hover if another navigation happened in the last 1s. simple debounce.
alex: sweet. can we aim for hotfix today? this is causing alerts from Sentry traces.
ci-bot: deploy pipeline queued for `pr/3812` (kevin/dedupe) — tests passing.
kevin: starting hotfix PR now, ping when CI green and I'll roll canary.
tanya: post-deploy, let's watch: metrics to monitor — client long tasks, kvcache eviction-rate, prefetch request rate, telemetry events emitted. patch notes in #eng-releases when live. :thumbsup:
alex: thanks all. I'll attach the minimal flame and kvcache snippet to the ticket.
